name: Cycle Separation of Ordering Width and Yang Depth
statement: Ordering width is unbounded on partial cubes. For every $s\geq1$, $\sigma(C_6^{\times s})=1$ while $\delta_{\mathrm{CM},k}(C_6^{\times s})=s$; thus Yang depth is not bounded by ordering width even on partial cubes.
proof: Ordering width takes the maximum under products, whereas Yang depth defect adds. Since $C_6$ has both values one, its Cartesian powers give the separation. The exact even-cycle formula separately makes ordering width unbounded.
